verification_evidence.static: Compared the file list and retained assertions with pre-marmot-library-adoption. All retained titles and assertions were preserved. The test runner serves the local Blossom mock through a certificate-pinned HTTPS proxy.
verification_evidence.browser: The integrated relay run passed abandon (3/3) and ever-known (6/6). A clean-relay Chromium run passed all seven poll-after-leave checks, along with off-screen join requests, multi-tab transfer and removal/re-invite (23/23 total). A separate run passed the active group join-request regression and notification-domain checks (10 passed, one baseline skip).

independent_review.structural: Independent Codex reviewer Beauvoir compared the test files directly with the pre-run tag. All 83 ordinary retained files are byte-for-byte identical. groups-admin retains all executable assertions, and the sole removed baseline spec is groups-blackout-guard.
independent_review.adversarial: Beauvoir checked the lease-bound dev hooks and active-view predicate. Its acceptance condition was the recorded execution of the seven retained poll-after-leave checks, which all passed in the focused run. Blocked database deletion handling is existing cleanup behavior and was recorded as a harness limitation.
